narrative_shape: Baseline capture that waits on long builds and then commits. Turn 70: pytest 518 before, 520 after, no failures. Turns 71–75 launch Perth j1/j4 and three full-AU builds under the heavy lock and wait. Checkpoint 90: unrelated sibling-unit files are left unstaged; owned paths are committed. Edit count stays at 5. Almost no reads (distinct paths 1 then 2). The wait is Contract W, and it ends in a commit.

phases.note: Sibling dirty files identified and avoided. Owned paths staged and committed. Read +1.
